title: Vinto parents block road over school-food baskets

organizer: Parents from several schools; representative Miguel Ángel Fernández
threshold_50_evidence: No simultaneous attendance count in opened source; vehicles, blockade points and sector workforce cannot establish the threshold.

start_date.summary: The opened January 13 Los Tiempos report confirms a morning blockade at Vinto municipal offices and resumption after an evening pause of about one hour.
